articles.title: Coinbase AI draws backlash after erroneously publishing World Cup result before kickoff
articles.snippet: CEO Brian Armstrong investigated, and the firm said it made updates to prevent future AI-generated inaccuracies.

articles.title: Banks have stopped asking if stablecoins belong in finance, now they're considering how
articles.snippet: Financial institutions are racing to become the secure gateways for stablecoins as digital asset volume is projected to explode by 2030.

articles.title: Bollinger Bands creator eyes Bitcoin bear-market end, 'W'-shaped reversal
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price strength could "break" the entire downtrend if the reversal pattern completed, John Bollinger suggested in light of the BTC rebound.

articles.title: US law enforcement group drops opposition to CLARITY Act: Report
articles.snippet: The Major County Sheriffs of America said it still wants the CLARITY Act amended to give local law enforcement more resources to investigate illicit finance cases.
